name: Southern Cable Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份分拆/附加上市、融资及股息相关事项，未见涉及各业务板块的产能、合约或新业务公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收5.276亿MYR，同比增25.8%；净利润4057万MYR，同比增28.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly related to share subdivision/additional listing, fund raising and dividends, with no announcements concerning capacity, contracts or new businesses of any business segment. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 527.6 million, up 25.8% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 40.6 million, up 28.2% year-on-year.
